description: February 16 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 16 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: February 16 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Late in Aquarius, about twenty-seven degrees in, February 16 brings the reflective 7. The Venus decan adds an eye for beauty and balance, while the 7 seeks underlying meaning. Traditionally this sketches an aesthetic philosopher: someone who enjoys ideas as much for their elegance as for their usefulness, and needs time alone to think.

On February 16 the Sun usually sits at about 27° Aquarius, in the third decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Uranus. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: February 16 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 16 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 16: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 16 is the 47th day of the year. By February 19, 3 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 16 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 108 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 16 include Octave Mirbeau (1848), Ernst Haeckel (1834) and Elizabeth Olsen (1989).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 16?
faq.answer: February 16 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 16 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 16?
faq.answer: February 16 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 108 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 16?
faq.answer: February 16 is also the birthday of Octave Mirbeau (1848), Ernst Haeckel (1834) and Elizabeth Olsen (1989). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
